g1_generator_availability.formula: A_cred_k(t) = Indicator(V_telemetry=VALID and OpStatus=OPERATIONAL and DispStatus=DISPATCHABLE)

g2_fuel_sufficiency.formula: E_fuel_credit = E_fuel_usable if V_fuel=VALID and E_fuel_usable >= Required else 0.0
g2_fuel_sufficiency.safeguard: UNKNOWN_INVALID != EMERGENCY. Fuel uncertainty sets generator credit to 0.0, does not auto-trigger Emergency.

g3_startup.formula: P_gen_credible(t) = 0.0 for t < t_startup else P_credible(t) if StartReady=VALID else 0.0 for all t
rules: OFF generator counts only after validated startup delay

g4_unknown_generator_health.rule: Unknown health sets generator credit to 0.0 kWh. Evaluates remaining verified resources. Does NOT auto-trigger Emergency.

g6_evidence_threshold.rule: Every required evidence field must be validated before generator energy credit. No silent substitution of defaults or nameplate values.
